title: feat(nmtriple): leftover axis of M and O at t+1 on #7167: reverse fails, face fails
science: Leftover lattice axis Lx = {e_1,e_2,e_3} \ (Axis(M) ∪ Axis(O)) on the #7208 y-probes. Lx is empty at all four probes; because the predicate makes empty leftover FAIL, this reports fail/fail. Its runner proves exactly the axis PARTITION (disjoint AND union = all three axes) that #7278 reports on the identical cell as hold/hold -- the same computation with inverted verdict labels.
